verdict: Both round-11 findings resolve as stated (R11-01 as M: T005 requirement (b); the glob order stays parked as P1). One new Advisory: T005's Ask-first field forecasts only checks although its acceptance now edits the approvals surface.

findings.section: plan.md T005 (Ask-first: checks; acceptance requirements (a) and (b))
findings.defect: The new acceptance requirements make T005 change the approvals globs of .github/ask-first.yaml and add the YAML and TOML readers under a path on approvals, but the Ask-first field still lists only checks. The field is the forecast other agents read to count locks (12 12.2 treats an ask-first surface as overlapping every in-flight PR).
findings.scenario: A scheduler reads T005 as touching one surface, starts it in parallel with other ci-bootstrap tasks, and finds at merge an approvals diff whose line was never forecast, serializing the whole tooling window late.
findings.change: List approvals beside checks in T005's Ask-first field, or say the approvals change is made in the one tooling pull request of stage B.

out_of_scope: ADR 0011 and 01/03/04/09 deltas only skimmed by stat; plan-wide critical path not redrawn (stage B).
